title: DJI envelope
description: The fields every DJI Cloud API message carries, from DJI's SDK, dji-sdk/DJI-Cloud-API-Demo at bef525cb (cloud-sdk/src/main/java/com/dji/sdk), serialised snake_case as its Common.getObjectMapper() does: mqtt/CommonTopicRequest and CommonTopicResponse. What so-gateway sends is held to these exactly; what a client sends is held to the types, and may carry more.

tid.description: Transaction: a request and its reply share it.

bid.description: Business: the messages of one piece of work share it.

own_id.description: A tid or bid so-gateway made: a random UUID, as DJI's SDK makes them.

sn.description: A serial number, as the SDK's REGEX_SN.

flag.description: A DJI boolean on the wire: 0 or 1, as DJI's examples send it; the SDK's Boolean fields accept it.

result.description: 0 is success; anything else is one of DJI's error codes (WaylineErrorCodeEnum, CommonErrorEnum).
